title: Experience at a moment is a property of the present physical state

statements.text: What is experienced at a moment is a property of the physical state, or event, at that moment. The frameworks that say so name different states: a topological pocket of a field, an orchestrated quantum reduction, the tones of a mesh at one beat, or whatever present property a theory identifies.

sources.quote: when 𝑋𝑡 is held constant between realizations, the general attribution function is identical across all histories
Consciousness must therefore be attributed to a system’s present state rather than to its past states.
Direct physical-state theories naturally satisfy this requirement.
This orchestrated OR activity (‘Orch OR’) is taken to result in moments of conscious awareness and/or choice.
this solutions identifies moments of experience with topological pockets of fields of physics
Consciousness is a network of integrated experience.
